blocks.text: The gallery Le Bonheur est dans l’instant presents, from November 17 to 29, 2026, an exhibition focusing mainly on the paintings of Patrice Huguier , shown alongside a selection of the fashion photographs by his wife, Françoise Huguier .
Le Bonheur est dans l’instant 72 Rue Amelot 75011 Paris, France
